summary: Iteration 25: verified customer confirmation emails (contact + booking), new /api/admin/email-preview endpoint, Arabic /ar/downloads + /ar/businesses pages, theme-aware EGMG logo (English + Arabic), Arabic nav/footer wiring, language toggle, and admin preview links. 7/7 backend tests pass (test_iter25_email_confirmations.py). All frontend acceptance criteria met with no runtime errors.

POST /api/bookings -> 200 in <2s, background tasks log team alert 'New chauffeur booking RL-...' AND customer 'Chauffeur booking RL-... received | تم استلام حجزك'
GET /api/admin/email-preview?type=booking -> 200 text/html; contains RL-SAMPLE01, EUROGULF MOBILITY GROUP, WE MOVE YOU!, 'تم استلام الحجز', '800 364', dir="rtl" section
GET /api/admin/email-preview?type=contact -> contains 'Sara Al Mansoori', 'we received your enquiry' (case-insensitive), 'استلمنا استفسارك'

/ar/downloads: dir=rtl, h1 'مركز التحميل', 6 cards ar-download-0..5, card 1 links to https://egmg.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/5-Pages-Fleet.pdf with text 'تحميل', others show 'قريباً', CTA -> /ar/contact

/ar/businesses: dir=rtl, 6 cards linking to /ar/europcar,/ar/goldcar,/ar/truckline,/ar/chauffeur-service,/ar/autocare,/ar/used-cars; all 6 logos load (naturalWidth > 0). Dark mode -> cards 2-5 use /egmg-logo-transparent.png; light mode -> cards 2-5 use /egmg-logo-dark-text.png
/ar hero light-mode h1 color rgb(238, 237, 231) confirmed on both ar-downloads-hero and ar-businesses-hero
Nav on /ar: nav-link-our-brands href=/ar/businesses; Arabic Support & Resources dropdown item 'مركز التحميل' -> /ar/downloads

Admin dashboard Enquiries tab: [data-testid='alerts-status'] renders with [data-testid='preview-contact-email'] (href .../api/admin/email-preview?type=contact) and [data-testid='preview-booking-email'] (href ...?type=booking); target=_blank; clicking booking opens new tab that renders 'Booking RL-SAMPLE01 received'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 320/350: BackgroundTasks correctly used to send team alert + customer confirmation without blocking response (measured <3s).
emailer.py uses html.escape (_h) consistently across _rows and _layout; user-supplied name/message is safely escaped.
Preview endpoint applies safe response headers (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, restrictive CSP).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up one TEST_ contact_submission and one TEST_ booking with email confirm-qa@test.ae.
